# Support

Sentri support happens through GitHub issues.

## Where To Ask

- Use bug reports for reproducible broken behavior.
- Use feature requests for product or engineering improvements.
- Use pull requests for proposed code or documentation changes.

## Before Opening An Issue

Check existing open and closed issues first. Include the smallest useful reproduction, affected component, expected behavior, actual behavior, and any logs or screenshots that help explain the problem.

## Maintainer Expectations

This is a small open-source project. Maintainers may close stale, duplicate, incomplete, or already-completed issues to keep the tracker actionable.

## Private Reports

Do not post secrets, credentials, private student data, or vulnerability details in public issues. For security concerns, follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
